title: Prove Pipes variable-charge spend after its grant contract is owned
description: Pipes of the Sewers now has green C1 charge economy and operation clauses, but useItem still refuses call-rat-swarms at the unmodified real-pack preflight because m4-pipes-of-the-sewers remains engine-pending on creature-grant lifecycle, controlled-entity action budget, and cooldown/identity ownership. This dispatch proved the real-record dawn 1d3 regain and separately verified that useItem refuses a variable spend larger than remaining charges; the exact Pipes 2-then-2-with-1-remaining sequence cannot reach cost validation without crossing the independent m4 boundary.\n\nAfter the existing grant contract is owned or otherwise resolved, add no-waiver real-pack evidence that spending 2 charges, refusing another 2 with 1 remaining, and crossing dawn restores 1d3 capped at 3. Preserve the current truthful refusal until that boundary changes.
